changelog: All Keyflow features unlocked for free
Long-press to adjust motion blur per layer
Copy & paste effect presets (multi-layer & percentage keyframes)
Shadow & Border controls for Text and Shape layers with keyframes
Effect Suites (.kfpack custom shader loader) in Settings
Auto-cancel preview when moving or editing in the workspace
Smooth vertical timeline scrolling even while a layer is selected
Smart export cache: skip re-exporting when no changes were made
Keep screen awake automatically during video export
Batch font management & seamless in-place updates
